name: aversion to strangers
quote: I don't usually hold with foreign food.
description: Anxiety about people who are unfamiliar or have different customs or language.
perceptions: This person or group has unfamiliar characteristics.
I don't know what to expect or how to behave.
results: desire to leave the unfamiliar context

guidance.description: In this article, we'll define social anxiety in general, explore specific social anxiety disorder symptoms, and share some strategies for overcoming social phobia.

variations.name: stranger danger
variations.description: Being distrustful of unknown people in general or of a specific type.
perceptions: This person or group is unknown to me.
They look hostile or could be dangerous in some way.
results: desire to remove yourself from the situation safely

guidance.description: People with xenophobia experience significant, sudden anxiety and distress when they are around strangers. They often go out of their way to avoid seeing, interacting with, or even thinking about strangers.

examples: teaching kids to be wary of strangers

variations.name: cultural discomfort
variations.description: Being uncomfortable with people who's looks, ideas, language, or customs are different than what you're familiar with.
perceptions: This person or group is unknown to me.
They have unfamiliar customs or language.
I don't know what to expect or how to behave.
results: desire to leave the unfamiliar context

guidance.description: Because social acceptance is so important to us, being amongst people with different outlooks and customs can be stressful. If you're going to travel or care to explore your reactions, here are some interesting references.

examples: person from another country or religion
person from the other side of the political spectrum

commentaries.quote: Some people thrive in a multicultural environment, enjoying frequent new experiences. Some do not, preferring familiar things.

I was a picky eater as a teen. I wanted to control this one aspect of my life and liked being an expert on hamburgers. I didn't want to look ignorant by not knowing about weird foods like 'falafels' and 'paneer'. It does take a while to become attuned to all that stuff. But life is long, and I'm glad I did.
